findings.title: Statement files parsed with unsafe yaml.load
findings.description: parse_statement() calls yaml.load with yaml.Loader on uploaded bank statements. This module took over bank feed parsing in the August importer refactor. A crafted statement file can instantiate arbitrary Python objects in the import worker, which leads to code execution.

findings.cweName: Insertion of Sensitive Information into Log File
findings.title: Payout webhook payloads logged in full
findings.description: The payout retry task logs the full webhook payload at INFO level, including beneficiary names and account suffixes.

findings.title: Unbounded webhook retry queue
findings.description: Failed webhook deliveries are retried forever with no cap, so one unreachable customer endpoint can fill the Celery queue and delay payouts for every customer.
